semantic_mapping: User described sound for changing activities; Drive Content-Disposition identifies Director - Select Mission. Used for confirmed changed activity-card selection and successful changed fireteam retarget, independent from Mission Click and Countdown. Filename and user-description inference; no original-game provenance or speaker-listening claim.
conversion: Full original decoded to stereo Vorbis q6 at44100Hz, no cuts or speed changes. End padded to original MP3 container duration; codec padding retained. Native Vorbis encoder used because local FFmpeg has no libvorbis.
dispatch_policy: Owner-only after a changed card selection commits; connected fireteam recipients after a changed retarget commits. No hover, repaint, same-ID, cancel or failed-change dispatch.
